title: Mexico’s Attorney General Charges Former Chihuahua Prosecutor with “Treason Against the Homeland” for Letting CIA In
author: SinEmbargo Staff
content:
_This article by[SinEmbargo
Staff](https://www.sinembargo.mx/author/redaccion/) originally appeared in the
[October 17, 2026 edition of SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4889266/la-
fgr-imputa-al-exfiscal-de-chihuahua-traicion-a-la-patria-por-dejar-entrar-a-
cia/), an independent Mexican digital news outlet._

**Mexico City, October 17 (SinEmbargo).—** The **former Attorney General of
Chihuahua,[César Gustavo Jáuregui
Moreno](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4889106/el-escandalo-de-la-cia-en-chihuahua-
cobra-su-primera-victima-cae-el-exfiscal-de-maru/)**, identified by
authorities as César "N", allegedly committed the crime of **Treason Against
the Homeland** over the operation carried out in April of this year in **El
Pinal** , located in the municipality of **Morelos,** in which a narco lab was
seized, by allowing agents of the US **Central Intelligence Agency** (CIA) to
take part in that action, the **Office of the Attorney General of the Republic
(FGR)** reported today.

> "The investigation determined that César 'N' allegedly engaged in acts
> possibly constituting the crime of treason against the homeland in matters
> of national security. This is because he allegedly allowed foreign persons
> to intervene without authorization on national territory and in actions that
> correspond only to federal forces," the head of the Attorney General's
> Office, Ernestina Godoy, said in a
> [message](https://fgr.org.mx/es/FGR/Nacional/_rid/61/_mod/story?p=1&ord=desc&f=0&categoria=Nacional&suri=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.FGR.swb%23fgr_Boletin%3A29443).

The Attorney General added that Jáuregui Moreno's actions violated the
sovereignty and integrity of Mexico, since foreign interference is expressly
prohibited in the country's Political Constitution.

"It is worth mentioning that our Constitution and the National Security Law
state that the federal entities are limited from assuming powers reserved to
the Federation, as well as from transferring public authority to foreign
authorities," Godoy commented.

There is **no public record** of people sentenced, charged or under formal
judicial proceedings, at least in the **last 50 years** , for the crime of
Treason Against the Homeland. The FGR's accusation against the former
prosecutor who served María Eugenia Campos is based on **Article 123 of the
Federal Penal Code**.

## What Did the FGR Detail About the Investigation Against the Former
Prosecutor?

In her message, the Attorney General mentioned that in the investigation file
on the El Pinal operation case it is "fully established" that the
participation of the **two CIA agents** was not justified, and that the former
prosecutor was not authorized to permit their involvement.

"Furthermore, it was proven that both foreign persons had gone on several
occasions, and without justified cause, to facilities of the State
Investigation Agency," the head of the FGR explained.

Likewise, she indicated that the state authority that led the operation, the
State Investigation Agency, "lacked the powers to carry out actions that are
exclusive to the Federation," since the National Security Law prohibits it.

Another point Godoy made was that César "N" withheld information from the
Chihuahua State Attorney General's Office (FGE) by not informing federal
authorities about the operation, and yet he did inform the foreign agents
about it.

> "He knew these were federal crimes. However, he notified the federal forces
> only after the operation, hastily and improperly. Federal authorities
> immediately took over the investigation to clarify the facts and determine
> responsibilities," the Attorney General stressed.

![Attorney General Ernestina Godoy](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/10/chihuahua-prosecutor-treason-
cia-02-godoy.jpg)Ernestina Godoy reported that the former Chihuahua prosecutor
withheld information from federal authorities. Photo: FGR

Finally, Ernestina Godoy stated that, from the first moment after the arrest
warrant against Jáuregui Moreno was executed, close communication has been
maintained between federal and state authorities.

She also maintained that the Office of the Attorney General of the Republic
will continue the relevant work "with diligence, professionalism and respect
for human rights and due process."

> We will be reporting on progress as the law allows us. Where there is
> impunity, there will be investigation. And where there is crime, there will
> be consequences.
>
> Attorney General Ernestina Godoy

César Gustavo Jáuregui Moreno was arrested this morning. The record published
in the **National Registry of Detentions** (RND) of the Secretariat of
Security and Citizen Protection (SSPC) detailed that the capture took place at
10:20 a.m. on La Cantera Avenue, at the George Washington Avenue bridge, in
the Campestre Washington neighborhood, in the capital city of Chihuahua.

The record indicates that Jáuregui Moreno was apprehended by State Police
officers and placed at the disposal of the State Attorney General's Office,
Central-South Zone. At the time the record was consulted, at 11:37 a.m., the
official was "in transit" to the Public Prosecutor's facilities.
